party_current_name: Opportunity (The Opportunity Party / TOP; Wikipedia lists the party as Opportunity (TOP))
results_note: Election 7 Nov 2026. ~86% counted on 8 Nov; ~399,000 special votes outstanding; official result due 27 Nov 2026. Party vote 5.96-6.02% depending on source/time. Seats appear to be list seats (candidates stood in electorates). Seat count could shift slightly after specials.
